commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Substitution. Siebe Van Der Heyden is replaced by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca).
90+7' Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+7' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
90+7' Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
90+5' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
90+3' A player from Mallorca takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' The referee is firm and issues Jaume Costa (Mallorca) a deserved yellow card.
90+1' Celta Vigo concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
90+1' Today's match ends for Daniel Rodriguez who will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vedat Muriqi departs the field of play to be replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) replacing Fran Beltran.
89' The game has come to an end for Carlos Dominguez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo).
89' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Mallorca is cautioned for aggressive play.
87' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is penalised.
87' A player from Mallorca commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
86' 0 - 1 GOAL! Daniel Rodriguez meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 0:1.
84' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Celta Vigo.
84' Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
83' The ball is out of play and Celta Vigo manage to earn a corner.
81' A player from Celta Vigo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
78' The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
77' A substitution has been made. Luca de la Torre is replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
76' Substitution. Manu Morlanes leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
76' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Toni Lato is replaced by Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
72' The Celta Vigo players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
72' Celebrations by Celta Vigo are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.

69' Iago Aspas passes the ball into the penalty area. Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
67' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jorgen Strand Larsen walks off the pitch to be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
64' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
60' A clumsy foul by Toni Lato (Mallorca) and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle.
60' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' One of the Mallorca players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
54' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
53' Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.
51' A player from Celta Vigo commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
50' The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.

49' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top right corner and forces a good save out of Predrag Rajkovic. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game. One of the players from Celta Vigo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
42' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
40' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
36' A free kick to Celta Vigo.
36' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
34' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
30' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
29' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.

25' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the right side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.
24' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mallorca.
22' What a big chance! Toni Lato (Mallorca) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
18' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
11' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
9' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
7' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
3' Celta Vigo have a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero will supervise the game today.
